statement: The provenance record indicates the item is elephant ivory carved in 2014 and imported from Cameroon in 2015, which violates U.S. federal regulations and CITES agreements regarding the commercial trade of ivory.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the item "violates U.S. federal regulations and CITES agreements regarding the commercial trade of ivory," contradicting the record's "permitted" status.
